findings.title: P1 leaves the hand-over protein stuck in the queen
findings.where: src/sim/colony/handover.ts provisionAtHandover (stomach-only pay-in, HANDOVER_PROVISION_WINDOW_GD 3) together with src/sim/colony/queen.ts (an established queen never draws reserveP)
findings.detail: Protein is paid in only as fast as the workers' stomachs empty, and the pay-in stops when the 3-gd window closes. Whatever is left stays in queen.reserveP for good. Probe on the sweep's own hand-overs (test-output/colony-life/round-5/sweep-review/probe-provision/): queen P above her 1.0 keep when the window closed was suburban-garden #1 9.72, playground-park #1 6.41, woodland-edge #2 5.32, car-park-verge #1 1.61, kitchen-door #1 0 and woodland-edge #1 0 (those two spent it on 9-11 larvae by gd 2). In suburban-garden #1 the 7 larvae hatched at gd 3.0-3.25 into pool P 0 while the queen held 10.7 P: 6 starved, 0 eclosed, and the stage check failed for 4.25 gd. This run went from viable to not viable. RED test kept: src/sim/colony/handoverStomach.verify.test.ts case 2 (queen keeps 7.37 of 8.6 P). P1c, the reverted try with a 10-gd window, was judged on the forage bench, where the tool holds demand up and empties the stomachs anyway, so the bench cannot show this.

findings.title: Save then load changes the ground height near the nest (mound overlay), so runs diverge
findings.where: the field height overlay vs the Mound state on restore (src/sim/nest/mounds.ts, moundBatch.ts, field overlay); older code, not changed this round
findings.detail: On the playground-park #3 hand-over, 2000 ticks in, snapshot then restore: field.height under 4 ants differs by 0.8-2.4 mm. Their micro temperature and body temperature then differ, and the state hash differs within 10 ticks (sweep-review/probe-restore-pp3.txt, probe-restore2-pp3.txt). No mound relaxation was running at the split. The year-two long run of pp #3 (restored hand-over) leaves the sweep's in-process run on day 1: 7 vs 11 workers at winter. The other four long runs match the sweep up to winter. Every --cache run and bench restores; fresh sweep runs do not.

findings.title: Workers kept by the R24 cap (WL2) never starve
findings.detail: The kept workers' food is charged after the winter model has run, and only as far as the stores go, so these workers draw no starvation. RED test kept: src/sim/colony/overwinter/sparedStarve.verify.test.ts. Setup: 20 workers, C 1.5, a nest that floods on every rainy day vs the same nest dry. On seed 5 the flooded colony wakes with 13 workers and the dry one with 9.
